lead.claim: Timing of ACL surgery impacts long-term walking mechanics.
lead.context: Why this matters: This systematic review found that delayed ACL reconstruction is linked to persistent sagittal plane deficits during walking.

supporting.claim: Can biofeedback reduce knee abduction angle in ACL injury prevention?
supporting.context: Why this matters: This systematic review suggests biofeedback may reduce peak knee abduction angle in ACL injury prevention, but evidence certainty is low.

supporting.claim: A standard multidisciplinary program for low back pain can be more cost-effective.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This retrospective cohort study found a standard multidisciplinary pathway was more cost-effective than a federal-funded pathway for low back pain.

supporting.claim: IMU-based gait analysis can objectively assess vestibular rehabilitation progress.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This observational study found IMU sensors, even single ones, can capture significant improvements in gait after vestibular rehabilitation.

supporting.claim: Use the same digital handgrip dynamometer to track patient progress.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This study found that different digital handgrip dynamometers have excellent reliability but are not interchangeable due to systematic differences.
